requirement.evidence: (4) The lessor shall, within thirty days after the termination of occupancy under a tenancy-at-will or the end of the tenancy as specified in a valid written lease agreement, return to the tenant the security deposit or any balance thereof;
requirement.note: Deductions, the 30-day return, treble damages and fees are supported. The yearly interest requirement applies only where the deposit is held for a year or longer. The treble damages cover failures under 6(a), (d) and (e), and the card's gloss is loose.

key_value.evidence: the tenant shall be awarded damages in an amount equal to three times the amount of such security deposit or balance thereof to which the tenant is entitled plus interest at the rate of five per cent from the date when such payment became due, together with court costs and reasonable attorney's fees.
